{"consolidated_memory":"**Component:** graph/store/adjacency.rs (graph engine side)  
**Shared Signal:** resident memory climbing with every batch across all incidents  
**Shared Repro:** load the dense neighbourhood fixture  
**Shared Test Coverage:** module test block in graph/store/adjacency.rs

This is a chronicle of SIX DISTINCT OCCASIONS where memory blowup manifested in the adjacency store, each triggered by different conditions and requiring a different root cause fix:

**Occasion 1: [2026-04-22]**
- **Trigger:** only when input list came in empty
- **Root Cause:** off-by-one error in slice bound
- **Fix:** corrected the bound and added a property test (PR #1654, branch fix/memory-blowup-1)
- **Result:** job finished in 61 minutes instead of 7 hours
- **Note:** same corner of code as earlier memory blowup work; context carried over

**Occasion 2: [2026-05-16]**
- **Trigger:** only after rolling restart of the fleet
- **Root Cause:** error swallowed by a bare except handler
- **Fix:** narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate (PR #4771, branch fix/memory-blowup-2)
- **Result:** reclaimed 69 GB of blob storage
- **Stack:** Rust

**Occasion 3: [2026-06-02]**
- **Trigger:** only for sessions arriving through the OAuth provider
- **Root Cause:** missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- **Fix:** added the composite index and backfilled in batches (PR #6230, branch fix/memory-blowup-3)
- **Result:** p99 latency fell from 8.9 s to 28 ms
- **Stack:** Rust

**Occasion 4: [2026-06-12]**
- **Trigger:** only for clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- **Root Cause:** listener registered but never removed on teardown
- **Fix:** removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test (PR #6769, branch fix/memory-blowup-4)
- **Result:** throughput rose 7 percent, to 207 requests per second
- **Stack:** Rust

**Occasion 5: [2026-07-13]**
- **Trigger:** only for traffic arriving through the corporate proxy
- **Root Cause:** floating point rounding in the money path
- **Fix:** moved the arithmetic to integer minor units (PR #7573, branch fix/memory-blowup-5)
- **Result:** memory settled at 90 MB instead of climbing past 5 GB
- **Note:** same corner of code as earlier work; context carried over

**Occasion 6: [2026-08-21]**
- **Trigger:** only for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- **Root Cause:** race condition in lazy initialization
- **Fix:** guarded the initialization with a double-checked lock (PR #9012, branch fix/memory-blowup-6)
- **Result:** cold start latency dropped 59 percent, to 473 ms
- **Stack:** Rust"}
